# Grizzly Research LLC

> > Independent forensic accounting and due diligence firm specializing in short-seller research and fraud investigations across global markets.

Grizzly Research LLC, founded by Siegfried Eggert, is a specialized research firm that conducts deep-dive investigations into corporate fraud, financial misconduct, and misrepresentation. The firm publishes detailed short-seller reports and forensic analyses targeting companies across technology, energy, media, and financial sectors globally, with particular focus on Nasdaq-listed companies and international markets including China, Germany, and Brazil.

## Key Topics

- Fraud allegations
- Short-seller reports
- Financial misconduct
- Due diligence
- Forensic accounting
- Stock analysis
- Manufacturing capacity fraud
- Financial misrepresentation
- Nasdaq companies
- Legal disputes
- Insider trading
- Ponzi schemes
- Whistleblower reports
- M&A analysis
- Corporate governance

## Featured Investigations

- [XP's Entire Profits Are Dependent on What Insiders Call a "Madoff-Like Ponzi Scheme"](https://grizzlyreports.com/xp-entire-profits-are-dependent-on-what-insiders-call-a-madoff-like-ponzi-scheme): Detailed fraud allegations against XP Inc.'s GLADIUS fund and structured products scheme.
- [Accor, Epstein, and Ukrainian Orphans: Our Investigation Into Child Trafficking](https://grizzlyreports.com/accor): Investigation into Accor SA's alleged involvement in child trafficking and human rights violations.
- [The "Trustpilot Mafia" – How the Extortion Model Destroys Trustpilot's Value Proposition](https://grizzlyreports.com/trustpilot): Investigation into Trustpilot's alleged extortion scheme and fake review platform integrity issues.
- [Insiders Attest That GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) Is Actively Committing Widespread Fraud](https://grizzlyreports.com/genedx-20250205): Whistleblower report on GeneDx's code stacking fraud and Medicaid billing misconduct.

## Technology & Manufacturing Fraud Reports

- [EOS Behind the Hype: Unmasking the Dark Reality of the Mysterious Korean Contract](https://grizzlyreports.com/eos): Short-seller report on Electro Optic Systems Holdings Ltd exposing financial misconduct and fraud.
- [MVST's House of Lies: The German Factory Stands Idle, the Chinese One Runs at Half Capacity, and the CCP Owns the Shop](https://grizzlyreports.com/mvst): Fraud investigation into Microvast Holdings' manufacturing capacity misrepresentation and CCP ties.
- [Archer Aviation, the Nikola of the Skies](https://grizzlyreports.com/achr20250827): Investigation into Archer Aviation's eVTOL aircraft fraud allegations and manufacturing capacity concerns.
- [Falsifying Data Can't Save You From Severe Competition: Why We Believe Pony AI Inc. is the Worst of the Robotaxi Hype](https://grizzlyreports.com/pony): Short report on Pony AI Inc.'s data falsification and competitive disadvantages in robotaxi market.
- [KULR: Exposing the Hype, Overpromises, Insider-Mistrust and Operational Chaos in an 'Everything-Tech' Mirage](https://grizzlyreports.com/kulr): Short report exposing KULR Technology Group's revenue manipulation and government contract fraud.
